item.description:
VIDEO | Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu: Vigilance and Anti-Corruption officials conducted searches at the Government Raja Mirasudar Hospital following allegations that bribes were being collected from visitors and pregnant women.

The hospital, located near the Old Bus Stand, has maternity, paediatrics, ophthalmology and dental departments. Thousands of patients from Thanjavur and neighbouring districts, including Ariyalur, Tiruvarur, Nagapattinam, Mayiladuthurai and Pudukkottai, visit the facility for treatment.

According to complaints, visitors seeking permission to meet patients admitted to the hospital wards were allegedly charged between Rs 50 and Rs 100. There were also allegations that pregnant women were being forced to pay Rs 1,000 for the birth of a male child and Rs 500 for a female child.

Acting on the complaints, vigilance officials conducted searches and checked watchmen, sanitation workers and women assisting nurses in the maternity ward.

Unaccounted cash was seized during the searches, and officials were questioning those concerned as part of the investigation.

item.title: 🚨 N0N RANSOMWARE GROUP LISTS 12 SHIPPING AND MARITIME VICTIMS, MOSTLY IN SOUTH KOREA The N0n extortion group has added a batch of shipping, port an...
item.description:
🚨 N0N RANSOMWARE GROUP LISTS 12 SHIPPING AND MARITIME VICTIMS, MOSTLY IN SOUTH KOREA

The N0n extortion group has added a batch of shipping, port and logistics companies to its leak site. Every listing is marked "NOT PAID - EXPOSED", with a countdown before data is due to leak.

Victims named:
* ILCS Pelindo, port logistics (Indonesia)
* Eurogate Tanger, container terminal (Morocco)
* Camellia Line, ferry/RoRo (Japan)
* Samjoo Maritime, ship management (South Korea)
* T2S, terminal systems (Brazil)
* Korea Ferry, ferry operations (South Korea)
* BKH ICD, inland container depot (South Korea)
* BMT IQ, marine surveying (UK)
* EUSU Logistics, logistics (South Korea)
* Dong-A Tanker, oil tanker shipping (South Korea)
* April Asia, port agency (Indonesia)
* Saehan Marine, ship agency (South Korea)

No data samples have been published yet, and none of the named companies had confirmed an incident at the time of writing.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
Seven of the 12 names are South Korean, which points to a campaign focused on the Korean maritime sector, possibly through a shared supplier or service provider. A leak-site entry is not proof of a breach.

This is an unverified ransomware-group claim, NOT confirmation that any of these companies was breached.

#DDW #DarkWeb #Ransomware #N0n #Maritime #Shipping #SouthKorea

item.description:
🇷🇺 🚨 LEONARDO[.]RU (RUSSIA) CUSTOMER DATABASE ALLEGEDLY OFFERED FOR SALE

A threat actor on an underground forum claims to be selling a 2026 customer database allegedly taken from Leonardo, a large Russian hobby and craft retail chain with 100+ stores in Russia, plus Belarus and Kazakhstan, and an online shop.

Based on the sample shown, the actor claims the dataset includes:
* Customer IDs and full names
* Dates of birth
* Phone numbers
* Email addresses
* Password hashes

No record count or price is shown in the listing.

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
If genuine, this is a phishing and account-takeover risk for Leonardo shoppers: expect fake loyalty, order or refund messages by email and SMS. Leonardo customer files from 2020 have circulated on leak sites before, so this may be recycled or repackaged data despite the "2026" label. Customers who reused their Leonardo password elsewhere should change it.

VIDEO | After attending the high tea meet, JMM leader Mahua Maji (@mahuamajilive) says, "Consultations were held with important people to seek their opinions on what should happen next and how it should be done. Nothing was being imposed on anyone; decisions would be taken by consensus. The issue that dominated today's discussions was Jantar Mantar. Jantar Mantar is a designated protest site where trade union members from across the country, economically weaker sections of society, students and others come to Delhi at their own expense to register their protests. If you shut down a place where people can hold democratic and peaceful protests, including non-violent movements, and tell them to hold their protests at Ramlila Maidan instead, that creates another problem. Ramlila Maidan remains booked throughout the year, and the rent for a single day is more than ₹1 lakh. Where are people supposed to get that kind of money? In a way, this is an attempt to undermine the constitutional rights guaranteed to us. In a democratic country, a system that restricts these rights is being encouraged. And as for the issue of SIR, the INDIA alliance will continue to raise it until Gyanesh Kumar resigns."

item.title: VIDEO | After hosting the high tea meet, Lok Sabha LoP and Congress leader Rahul Gandhi (@RahulGandhi) says, "We are all standing here together as one...
item.description:
VIDEO | After hosting the high tea meet, Lok Sabha LoP and Congress leader Rahul Gandhi (@RahulGandhi) says, "We are all standing here together as one. As I said yesterday, there are no parallel protests. There is one singular protest, and the protest has one mission: restoration of democracy in India. Democracy has been destroyed in this country. The election system has been destroyed. The Constitution has been torn up and thrown away. We are fighting together to restore democratic rule, genuine democratic rule in this country. The one method of expression of democracy was Jantar Mantar and now the government has decided that Jantar Mantar can no longer be used to express democratic feelings. Well, we are going to challenge that idea. It is not going to be so simple for the government to decide that the Indian people will not fight for their voice. The people who have done this, they need to understand that the net is closing around them. It is not going to be so simple that you can destroy the Indian Constitution and get away with it. Yesterday you saw an expression, not of the political parties standing here, but an expression of the people of India. We were there, but what happened yesterday could not have happened without the expression of the average citizen of this country, non-political citizen of this country. So the first thing as a group we would like to do is we would like to thank the people of Delhi, the people of India who stood with us against what is being done. This is not about us, this is about the people of India, this is about the future of the people of India. And we, all of us together, because we love you and we respect you are going to fight to the end to restore the democratic process in this country. It is our commitment, the people who have done this, are going to be brought to justice."

#HighTea #ElectionCommission
